answer: What survives to the jetty is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The wharf is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the lotus. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work, idle agents bleed standing.
